integrity: Analytic proof is self-contained; numerical checks are finite and are not presented as a proof of asymptotics. The reviewed claim is not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Single generator f(z)=1-z and degree-one approximants for real p>1; the limit is as p tends to infinity at fixed polynomial degree. No higher-degree or other-generator result and no higher-order remainder is claimed.
title: A logarithmic boundary layer for linear optimal polynomial approximants in Hardy spaces
